items.question: Trong câu "Looking up a user by id, checking a word against a list, finding a substring — we take it for granted because JavaScript ships ready-made methods:", từ "take for granted" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Looking up a user by id, checking a word against a list, finding a substring — we take it for granted because JavaScript ships ready-made methods:", what does "take for granted" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to consider to be a mistake
to assume without thinking about it
items.explanation: take for granted /teɪk fər ˈɡrɑːntɪd/ (cụm từ): coi là hiển nhiên. Thường dùng "take it for granted that…" = mặc định điều gì đó luôn có sẵn nên không để ý tới nó.
items.explanationEn: take for granted /teɪk fər ˈɡrɑːntɪd/ (phrase): to assume without thinking about it. Often "take it for granted that…": to treat something as always available, so you stop noticing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Looking up a user by id, checking a word against a list, finding a substring — we take it for granted because JavaScript ships ready-made methods:", từ "ready-made" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Looking up a user by id, checking a word against a list, finding a substring — we take it for granted because JavaScript ships ready-made methods:", what does "ready-made" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: already made and ready to use
items.explanation: ready-made /ˌrediˈmeɪd/ (tính từ): làm sẵn, có sẵn. "Ready-made solution/methods" = giải pháp/hàm có sẵn, không cần tự viết.
items.explanationEn: ready-made /ˌrediˈmeɪd/ (adjective): already made and ready to use. "Ready-made solution/methods" means something you can use as-is without writing it yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "Looking up a user by id, checking a word against a list, finding a substring — we take it for granted because JavaScript ships ready-made methods:", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Looking up a user by id, checking a word against a list, finding a substring — we take it for granted because JavaScript ships ready-made methods:", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): đi kèm, cung cấp sẵn. Trong phần mềm, "X ships with Y" = X phát hành kèm sẵn Y; nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển bằng tàu.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to come with, to include. In software, "X ships with Y" means X is released with Y included; the original sense is to send by boat.

items.question: Trong câu "All four simply walk the array from the start and stop at the first hit.", từ "hit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All four simply walk the array from the start and stop at the first hit.", what does "hit" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a successful match in a search
items.explanation: hit /hɪt/ (danh từ): kết quả khớp (khi tìm). "First hit" = kết quả khớp đầu tiên; "cache hit" = tìm thấy trong cache.
items.explanationEn: hit /hɪt/ (noun): a successful match in a search. "First hit" is the first matching result; "cache hit" means the item was found in the cache.

items.question: Trong câu "One quirk: [NaN].indexOf(NaN) is -1 (because NaN !== NaN), while [NaN].includes(NaN) is true.", từ "quirk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One quirk: [NaN].indexOf(NaN) is -1 (because NaN !== NaN), while [NaN].includes(NaN) is true.", what does "quirk" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quirk /kwɜːk/ (danh từ): điểm kỳ quặc. Hay gặp trong "a quirk of JavaScript" = một hành vi lạ, khó đoán của ngôn ngữ.
items.explanationEn: quirk /kwɜːk/ (noun): an odd, unexpected behaviour. Common in "a quirk of JavaScript": a strange, surprising behaviour of the language.

items.question: Trong câu "The right algorithm depends on what you know: unsorted data forces a linear scan, sorted data unlocks binary search, and text has its own algorithms.", từ "unlock" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The right algorithm depends on what you know: unsorted data forces a linear scan, sorted data unlocks binary search, and text has its own algorithms.", what does "unlock" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to open a lock with a key
items.explanation: unlock /ʌnˈlɒk/ (động từ): mở ra khả năng. Nghĩa bóng: "unlock a feature/possibility" = làm cho điều gì trở nên khả thi; nghĩa đen là mở khóa.
items.explanationEn: unlock /ʌnˈlɒk/ (verb): to make something possible. Figurative: "unlock a feature/possibility" means to make it available; literally it means to open a lock.

items.question: Trong câu "Linear search checks every element in turn until it finds the target or runs out of elements.", từ "in turn" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linear search checks every element in turn until it finds the target or runs out of elements.", what does "in turn" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in turn /ɪn tɜːn/ (cụm từ): lần lượt từng cái. "Check each item in turn" = kiểm tra lần lượt từng phần tử; "in turn" còn có nghĩa "đến lượt mình".
items.explanationEn: in turn /ɪn tɜːn/ (phrase): one after another, in order. "Check each item in turn" means one by one; "in turn" can also mean "as a result, in its own turn".

items.question: Trong câu "Linear search checks every element in turn until it finds the target or runs out of elements.", từ "run out of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linear search checks every element in turn until it finds the target or runs out of elements.", what does "run out of" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to add a lot more of
to have no more of something
items.explanation: run out of /rʌn aʊt əv/ (cụm từ): hết, cạn (thứ gì). "Run out of memory/time/elements" = hết bộ nhớ/thời gian/phần tử.
items.explanationEn: run out of /rʌn aʊt əv/ (phrase): to have no more of something. "Run out of memory/time/elements" means there is none left.

items.question: Trong câu "Linear search is not "bad": on unsorted data it is the best you can do for a single lookup, because any element you skip could be the target.", từ "skip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linear search is not "bad": on unsorted data it is the best you can do for a single lookup, because any element you skip could be the target.", what does "skip" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to leave out, to pass over
items.explanation: skip /skɪp/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "Skip an element/step" = bỏ qua một phần tử/bước; nghĩa gốc là nhảy nhẹ.
items.explanationEn: skip /skɪp/ (verb): to leave out, to pass over. "Skip an element/step" means not processing it; the literal sense is to jump lightly.

items.question: Trong câu "Linear search is not "bad": on unsorted data it is the best you can do for a single lookup, because any element you skip could be the target.", từ "lookup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linear search is not "bad": on unsorted data it is the best you can do for a single lookup, because any element you skip could be the target.", what does "lookup" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an act of searching for a value
items.explanation: lookup /ˈlʊkʌp/ (danh từ): lần tra cứu. Danh từ "lookup" (viết liền); động từ là "look up" (viết rời). "O(1) lookup" = tra cứu O(1).
items.explanationEn: lookup /ˈlʊkʌp/ (noun): an act of searching for a value. The noun is "lookup" (one word); the verb is "look up". "O(1) lookup" means constant-time retrieval.

items.question: Trong câu "It also works on anything iterable (linked lists, streams).", từ "iterable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It also works on anything iterable (linked lists, streams).", what does "iterable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: iterable /ˈɪtərəbl/ (tính từ): duyệt qua được. "Iterable" = đối tượng có thể lặp qua từng phần tử, ví dụ mảng, chuỗi, Set.
items.explanationEn: iterable /ˈɪtərəbl/ (adjective): able to be looped over. "Iterable" describes an object whose items can be visited one by one, e.g. arrays, strings, Sets.

items.question: Trong câu "It also works on anything iterable (linked lists, streams).", từ "stream" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It also works on anything iterable (linked lists, streams).", what does "stream" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stream /striːm/ (danh từ): luồng dữ liệu. Trong lập trình, "stream" là luồng dữ liệu đến dần; nghĩa thường là dòng suối.
items.explanationEn: stream /striːm/ (noun): a continuous flow of data. In programming a "stream" is data arriving piece by piece; in everyday English it is a small river.

items.question: Trong câu "The right algorithm depends on what you know: unsorted data forces a linear scan, sorted data unlocks binary search, and text has its own algorithms.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The right algorithm depends on what you know: unsorted data forces a linear scan, sorted data unlocks binary search, and text has its own algorithms.", what does "force" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːs/ (động từ): buộc phải, bắt phải. "X forces Y" = X khiến Y trở thành bắt buộc; "force push" = ép đẩy (git).
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːs/ (verb): to make necessary, to compel. "X forces Y" means X leaves no choice but Y; compare "force push" in git.

items.question: Trong câu "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", từ "throw away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", what does "throw away" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to get rid of, to discard
items.explanation: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. "Throw away half the data" = loại bỏ một nửa dữ liệu khỏi phạm vi xét.
items.explanationEn: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to get rid of, to discard. "Throw away half the data" means removing it from consideration.

items.question: Trong câu "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", từ "remaining" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", what does "remaining" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn lại. "The remaining elements/candidates" = các phần tử/ứng viên còn lại chưa xét.
items.explanationEn: remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ (adjective): still left over. "The remaining elements/candidates" are those not yet eliminated.

items.question: Trong câu "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", từ "candidate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", what does "candidate" (noun) mean?
options: phần tử có thể là đáp án
optionsEn: a person applying for a job
items.explanation: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (danh từ): phần tử có thể là đáp án. Trong thuật toán, "candidate" = lựa chọn còn có thể đúng; nghĩa thường là ứng viên (xin việc, bầu cử).
items.explanationEn: candidate /ˈkændɪdət/ (noun): a possible answer still considered. In algorithms a "candidate" is an option that may still be the answer; normally it is a job or election applicant.

items.question: Trong câu "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", từ "divide and conquer" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each comparison throws away half of the remaining candidates instead of one — divide and conquer applied to searching.", what does "divide and conquer" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: splitting a problem into smaller parts
items.explanation: divide and conquer /dɪˈvaɪd ənd ˈkɒŋkə/ (cụm từ): chia để trị. "Divide and conquer" = kỹ thuật chia bài toán thành bài toán con nhỏ hơn, như binary search, merge sort.
items.explanationEn: divide and conquer /dɪˈvaɪd ənd ˈkɒŋkə/ (phrase): splitting a problem into smaller parts. "Divide and conquer" breaks a problem into smaller subproblems, as in binary search and merge sort.

items.question: Trong câu "Binary search needs sorted data with random access (O(1) access by index).", từ "random access" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Binary search needs sorted data with random access (O(1) access by index).", what does "random access" (phrase) mean?
options: truy cập trực tiếp theo vị trí
truy cập ngẫu nhiên, tùy hứng
optionsEn: access in order from the start
items.explanation: random access /ˈrændəm ˈækses/ (cụm từ): truy cập trực tiếp theo vị trí. "Random access" không có nghĩa là "ngẫu nhiên" mà là truy cập bất kỳ vị trí nào trong O(1).
items.explanationEn: random access /ˈrændəm ˈækses/ (phrase): direct access to any position. "Random access" does not mean "by chance"; it means reaching any position in O(1).

items.question: Trong câu "On an unsorted array it silently returns wrong answers; on a linked list, reaching the middle costs O(n).", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On an unsorted array it silently returns wrong answers; on a linked list, reaching the middle costs O(n).", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): âm thầm, không báo lỗi. "Fail silently" = hỏng mà không báo lỗi, rất khó phát hiện; nghĩa thường là im lặng.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without any warning or error. "Fail silently" means failing without an error, which makes the bug hard to spot; literally it means quietly.

items.question: Trong câu "Two pointers, left and right, bound the part of the array where the target could still be.", từ "bound" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two pointers, left and right, bound the part of the array where the target could still be.", what does "bound" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (động từ): giới hạn, bao quanh. "Bound a range" = tạo biên của một khoảng; danh từ "bound" = cận (lower/upper bound).
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (verb): to form the limits of. "Bound a range" means marking its edges; the noun "bound" is a limit (lower/upper bound).

items.question: Trong câu "Two pointers, left and right, bound the part of the array where the target could still be.", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two pointers, left and right, bound the part of the array where the target could still be.", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə/ (danh từ): biến trỏ vị trí. Trong kỹ thuật "two pointers", pointer là biến chứa chỉ số; "a pointer" còn nghĩa là lời gợi ý.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə/ (noun): a variable marking a position. In the "two pointers" technique a pointer is an index variable; "a pointer" can also mean a tip.

items.question: Trong câu "The invariant: if the target exists, its index is in [left, right].", từ "invariant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The invariant: if the target exists, its index is in [left, right].", what does "invariant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: invariant /ɪnˈveəriənt/ (danh từ): điều kiện luôn đúng. "Loop invariant" = điều kiện đúng trước và sau mỗi vòng lặp, dùng để chứng minh thuật toán đúng.
items.explanationEn: invariant /ɪnˈveəriənt/ (noun): a condition that always holds. A "loop invariant" is true before and after every iteration and is used to prove correctness.

items.question: Trong câu "right starts at arr.length - 1, the last valid index, because the range is inclusive.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "right starts at arr.length - 1, the last valid index, because the range is inclusive.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "Valid index/input" = chỉ số/đầu vào hợp lệ; trái nghĩa là "invalid".
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (adjective): allowed and correct. "Valid index/input" means an acceptable one; the opposite is "invalid".

items.question: Trong câu "right starts at arr.length - 1, the last valid index, because the range is inclusive.", từ "inclusive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "right starts at arr.length - 1, the last valid index, because the range is inclusive.", what does "inclusive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inclusive /ɪnˈkluːsɪv/ (tính từ): bao gồm cả hai đầu. "Inclusive range [a, b]" = khoảng gồm cả a và b; ngược lại là "exclusive". Nghĩa xã hội: hòa nhập.
items.explanationEn: inclusive /ɪnˈkluːsɪv/ (adjective): including the end values. An "inclusive range [a, b]" contains both a and b; the opposite is "exclusive". Socially it means welcoming to all.

items.question: Trong câu "The new range excludes mid (mid + 1 / mid - 1), so it shrinks every iteration and the loop always ends.", từ "exclude" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The new range excludes mid (mid + 1 / mid - 1), so it shrinks every iteration and the loop always ends.", what does "exclude" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exclude /ɪkˈskluːd/ (động từ): loại ra, không bao gồm. "Exclude X from Y" = loại X khỏi Y; tính từ "exclusive" = không bao gồm.
items.explanationEn: exclude /ɪkˈskluːd/ (verb): to leave out, not include. "Exclude X from Y" means leaving X out of Y; the adjective is "exclusive".

items.question: Trong câu "The new range excludes mid (mid + 1 / mid - 1), so it shrinks every iteration and the loop always ends.", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The new range excludes mid (mid + 1 / mid - 1), so it shrinks every iteration and the loop always ends.", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu hẹp lại. "The range shrinks" = phạm vi nhỏ dần; quá khứ: shrank, shrunk. Nghĩa đời thường: vải co lại.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to become smaller. "The range shrinks" means it gets smaller; past forms shrank, shrunk. Clothes also shrink in the wash.

items.question: Trong câu "The new range excludes mid (mid + 1 / mid - 1), so it shrinks every iteration and the loop always ends.", từ "iteration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The new range excludes mid (mid + 1 / mid - 1), so it shrinks every iteration and the loop always ends.", what does "iteration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: iteration /ˌɪtəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): một vòng lặp. "Each iteration" = mỗi lần chạy thân vòng lặp; "iteration" cũng có nghĩa là một phiên bản cải tiến.
items.explanationEn: iteration /ˌɪtəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): one pass through a loop. "Each iteration" is one run of the loop body; "iteration" can also mean a new version of a design.

items.question: Trong câu "Binary search is easy to explain and easy to get subtly wrong.", từ "subtly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Binary search is easy to explain and easy to get subtly wrong.", what does "subtly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách tinh vi, khó thấy
items.explanation: subtly /ˈsʌtli/ (trạng từ): một cách tinh vi, khó thấy. "Subtly wrong" = sai ở chỗ rất nhỏ, khó phát hiện; danh từ "subtlety" /ˈsʌtlti/.
items.explanationEn: subtly /ˈsʌtli/ (adverb): in a small, hard-to-notice way. "Subtly wrong" means wrong in a small way that is hard to spot; noun "subtlety".

items.question: Trong câu "Most bugs come from mixing two conventions.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most bugs come from mixing two conventions.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an agreed way of doing something
a change from one form to another
items.explanation: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (danh từ): quy ước. "Naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên; "convention" cũng nghĩa là hội nghị. Đừng nhầm với "conversion".
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (noun): an agreed way of doing something. "Naming convention" is an agreed naming style; "convention" also means a conference. Do not confuse with "conversion".

items.question: Trong câu "Two consistent templates — pick one and never mix them:", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two consistent templates — pick one and never mix them:", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán. "Be consistent with…" = nhất quán với…; trái nghĩa "inconsistent".
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): following the same rules throughout. "Be consistent with…" means matching it without contradiction; opposite "inconsistent".

items.question: Trong câu "Two consistent templates — pick one and never mix them:", từ "template" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two consistent templates — pick one and never mix them:", what does "template" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: template /ˈtempleɪt/ (danh từ): khuôn mẫu. "Code template" = khung code mẫu để áp dụng lại; đừng nhầm với "temple" (đền).
items.explanationEn: template /ˈtempleɪt/ (noun): a pattern to follow. A "code template" is a reusable skeleton; do not confuse it with "temple".

items.question: Trong câu "In JavaScript numbers are exact up to 2⁵³, so (left + right) / 2 cannot overflow; in Java or C++ write left + (right - left) / 2.", từ "overflow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In JavaScript numbers are exact up to 2⁵³, so (left + right) / 2 cannot overflow; in Java or C++ write left + (right - left) / 2.", what does "overflow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˌəʊvəˈfləʊ/ (động từ): tràn số. "Integer overflow" = tràn số nguyên khi giá trị vượt quá giới hạn kiểu dữ liệu; nghĩa gốc là nước tràn.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˌəʊvəˈfləʊ/ (verb): to exceed the maximum value. "Integer overflow" happens when a value exceeds its type's limit; literally, liquid spilling over.

items.question: Trong câu "In JavaScript numbers are exact up to 2⁵³, so (left + right) / 2 cannot overflow; in Java or C++ write left + (right - left) / 2.", từ "exact" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In JavaScript numbers are exact up to 2⁵³, so (left + right) / 2 cannot overflow; in Java or C++ write left + (right - left) / 2.", what does "exact" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exact /ɪɡˈzækt/ (tính từ): chính xác tuyệt đối. "Exact up to 2⁵³" = biểu diễn chính xác đến 2⁵³; "exact match" = khớp hoàn toàn.
items.explanationEn: exact /ɪɡˈzækt/ (adjective): completely correct, with no error. "Exact up to 2⁵³" means stored without rounding up to that limit; "exact match" means identical.

items.question: Trong câu "Pass indices, not arr.slice(...): slicing copies half the array on each call (O(n) extra work overall) and loses the original indices.", từ "overall" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pass indices, not arr.slice(...): slicing copies half the array on each call (O(n) extra work overall) and loses the original indices.", what does "overall" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: overall /ˌəʊvərˈɔːl/ (trạng từ): tính tổng cộng. "Overall" = xét tổng thể; danh từ "overalls" lại là quần yếm.
items.explanationEn: overall /ˌəʊvərˈɔːl/ (adverb): in total, taking everything together. "Overall" means taking everything into account; the noun "overalls" is a type of clothing.

items.question: Trong câu "Why O(log n)? After k steps at most n / 2ᵏ candidates remain, so the range is empty after about log₂ n steps — precisely, at most ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 comparisons.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why O(log n)? After k steps at most n / 2ᵏ candidates remain, so the range is empty after about log₂ n steps — precisely, at most ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 comparisons.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (trạng từ): nói chính xác thì. "Precisely" thường đứng sau một ước lượng để đưa ra con số chính xác; "more precisely" = nói chính xác hơn.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (adverb): to be exact. "Precisely" often follows an estimate to give the exact figure; "more precisely" is also common.

items.question: Trong câu "Why O(log n)? After k steps at most n / 2ᵏ candidates remain, so the range is empty after about log₂ n steps — precisely, at most ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 comparisons.", từ "remain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why O(log n)? After k steps at most n / 2ᵏ candidates remain, so the range is empty after about log₂ n steps — precisely, at most ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 comparisons.", what does "remain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/ (động từ): còn lại. "X remain(s)" = X còn lại; tính từ "remaining", danh từ "remainder" (phần dư).
items.explanationEn: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/ (verb): to be left over. "X remain(s)" means X is still left; related: "remaining", "remainder".

items.question: Trong câu "Doubling the data adds just one step.", từ "double" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Doubling the data adds just one step.", what does "double" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: double /ˈdʌbl/ (động từ): tăng gấp đôi. "Double the input size" = tăng kích thước đầu vào lên gấp đôi; trái nghĩa "halve".
items.explanationEn: double /ˈdʌbl/ (verb): to make twice as large. "Double the input size" means making it twice as big; the opposite is "halve".

items.question: Trong câu "Both versions are O(1) in the best case (target at the first mid) and O(log n) on average and worst.", từ "on average" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both versions are O(1) in the best case (target at the first mid) and O(log n) on average and worst.", what does "on average" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on average /ɒn ˈævərɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): tính trung bình. "On average" = tính trung bình; hay gặp cùng "average-case complexity".
items.explanationEn: on average /ɒn ˈævərɪdʒ/ (phrase): typically, as a mean value. "On average" means as a typical value; often paired with "average-case complexity".

items.question: Trong câu "Space is O(1) iterative, O(log n) recursive (call stack).", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space is O(1) iterative, O(log n) recursive (call stack).", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy. "Recursive function" = hàm tự gọi lại chính nó; danh từ "recursion".
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (adjective): calling itself. A "recursive function" calls itself; the noun is "recursion".

items.question: Trong câu "With duplicates, plain binary search returns whichever match mid hits first: for [2, 4, 4, 4, 7] and 4 it returns 2, not 1.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With duplicates, plain binary search returns whichever match mid hits first: for [2, 4, 4, 4, 7] and 4 it returns 2, not 1.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (danh từ): giá trị trùng lặp. Danh từ /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ = bản trùng; động từ /ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/ = nhân bản.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (noun): a value that appears again. The noun /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ is a repeated copy; the verb /ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/ means to copy.

items.question: Trong câu "With duplicates, plain binary search returns whichever match mid hits first: for [2, 4, 4, 4, 7] and 4 it returns 2, not 1.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With duplicates, plain binary search returns whichever match mid hits first: for [2, 4, 4, 4, 7] and 4 it returns 2, not 1.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): thông thường, cơ bản. "Plain version/object" = bản cơ bản không thêm gì; "plain text" = văn bản thuần.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): basic, with nothing added. "Plain version/object" means the basic form with no extras; "plain text" is unformatted text.

items.question: Trong câu "With duplicates, plain binary search returns whichever match mid hits first: for [2, 4, 4, 4, 7] and 4 it returns 2, not 1.", từ "whichever" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With duplicates, plain binary search returns whichever match mid hits first: for [2, 4, 4, 4, 7] and 4 it returns 2, not 1.", what does "whichever" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: whichever /wɪtʃˈevə/ (tính từ): bất kỳ cái nào. "Whichever comes first" = cái nào đến trước thì chọn cái đó.
items.explanationEn: whichever /wɪtʃˈevə/ (adjective): any one that. "Whichever comes first" means the one that happens first, no matter which.

items.question: Trong câu "The fix is the lower bound — the first index whose value is >= target.", từ "lower bound" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The fix is the lower bound — the first index whose value is >= target.", what does "lower bound" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the highest limit of a range
the lowest limit of a range
items.explanation: lower bound /ˈləʊə baʊnd/ (cụm từ): cận dưới. "Lower bound" = cận dưới; trong tìm kiếm là chỉ số đầu tiên có giá trị >= target. Ngược lại: "upper bound".
items.explanationEn: lower bound /ˈləʊə baʊnd/ (phrase): the lowest limit of a range. "Lower bound" is the bottom limit; in search, the first index whose value is >= target. Opposite: "upper bound".

items.question: Trong câu "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", từ "naive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", what does "naive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (tính từ): đơn giản, chưa tối ưu. "Naive approach/solution" = cách làm thẳng, đơn giản nhất; nghĩa đời thường là ngây thơ.
items.explanationEn: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (adjective): simple and not optimized. "Naive approach/solution" is the most straightforward method; in daily use it means too trusting.

items.question: Trong câu "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", từ "approach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", what does "approach" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a way of dealing with a problem
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (danh từ): cách tiếp cận. "Approach to a problem" = cách giải quyết; động từ "approach" = tiến lại gần.
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (noun): a way of dealing with a problem. "An approach to a problem" is a method; the verb "approach" means to come closer.

items.question: Trong câu "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", từ "character by character" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", what does "character by character" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: character by character /ˈkærəktə baɪ ˈkærəktə/ (cụm từ): từng ký tự một. Cấu trúc "X by X" = lần lượt từng X: "step by step", "line by line".
items.explanationEn: character by character /ˈkærəktə baɪ ˈkærəktə/ (phrase): one letter at a time. The pattern "X by X" means one X at a time: "step by step", "line by line".

items.question: Trong câu "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", từ "mismatch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The naive approach tries every starting position and compares character by character, stopping at the first mismatch.", what does "mismatch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a place where things do not match
items.explanation: mismatch /ˈmɪsmætʃ/ (danh từ): chỗ không khớp. "Type mismatch" = không khớp kiểu; "stop at the first mismatch" = dừng ở chỗ khác đầu tiên.
items.explanationEn: mismatch /ˈmɪsmætʃ/ (noun): a place where things do not match. "Type mismatch" means incompatible types; "stop at the first mismatch" means at the first difference.

items.question: Trong câu "There are n - m + 1 start positions, each costing up to m comparisons: O(n · m) time, O(1) space.", từ "up to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There are n - m + 1 start positions, each costing up to m comparisons: O(n · m) time, O(1) space.", what does "up to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up to /ʌp tuː/ (cụm từ): tối đa là. "Up to m" = nhiều nhất m; "it's up to you" lại nghĩa là tùy bạn quyết định.
items.explanationEn: up to /ʌp tuː/ (phrase): as many as, at most. "Up to m" means m at most; "it's up to you" means it is your decision.

items.question: Trong câu "Naive search wastes information.", từ "waste" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to use badly or throw away
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (động từ): lãng phí, bỏ phí. "Waste time/memory/information" = lãng phí thời gian/bộ nhớ/thông tin.
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (verb): to use badly or throw away. "Waste time/memory/information" means using it without benefit.

items.question: Trong câu "Naive search shifts by one and re-reads text it has already seen.", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to move to a new position
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): dịch chuyển. "Shift by one" = dịch sang một vị trí; danh từ "shift" còn nghĩa là ca làm việc.
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to move to a new position. "Shift by one" means move one position; the noun "shift" also means a work period.

items.question: Trong câu "The Knuth–Morris–Pratt (KMP) algorithm (1977) avoids that.", từ "avoid" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (verb): to keep from doing something. Use "avoid + -ing": "avoid re-reading the text" means not doing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask: what is the longest proper prefix of the pattern that is also a suffix of the matched part?", từ "proper" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask: what is the longest proper prefix of the pattern that is also a suffix of the matched part?", what does "proper" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: proper /ˈprɒpə/ (tính từ): thực sự, không toàn bộ. Trong toán học/chuỗi, "proper prefix/subset" = tiền tố/tập con không bằng toàn bộ; nghĩa thường là phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: proper /ˈprɒpə/ (adjective): smaller than the whole. In maths and strings, "proper prefix/subset" excludes the whole thing; in daily use it means suitable.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask: what is the longest proper prefix of the pattern that is also a suffix of the matched part?", từ "suffix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: suffix /ˈsʌfɪks/ (danh từ): hậu tố, phần cuối. "Suffix" = phần cuối chuỗi (vd. "-ing"); đối lập với "prefix".
items.explanationEn: suffix /ˈsʌfɪks/ (noun): a part at the end. A "suffix" is added or found at the end (e.g. "-ing"); the opposite is "prefix".

items.question: Trong câu "So the pattern slides forward to line its first two characters up with the last two we read, and comparison resumes at pattern index 2 — the text pointer never moves backwards.", từ "slide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So the pattern slides forward to line its first two characters up with the last two we read, and comparison resumes at pattern index 2 — the text pointer never moves backwards.", what does "slide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slide /slaɪd/ (động từ): trượt, dịch dần. "Sliding window" = cửa sổ trượt; "slide forward" = trượt về phía trước. Danh từ "slide" còn là trang chiếu.
items.explanationEn: slide /slaɪd/ (verb): to move smoothly along. "Sliding window" is a common technique; the noun "slide" is also a presentation page.

items.question: Trong câu "So the pattern slides forward to line its first two characters up with the last two we read, and comparison resumes at pattern index 2 — the text pointer never moves backwards.", từ "line up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to put in the same position
items.explanation: line up /laɪn ʌp/ (cụm từ): căn cho thẳng hàng. "Line X up with Y" = căn X cho thẳng hàng với Y; "line up" còn nghĩa là xếp hàng.
items.explanationEn: line up /laɪn ʌp/ (phrase): to put in the same position. "Line X up with Y" means align them; "line up" can also mean to form a queue.

items.question: Trong câu "So the pattern slides forward to line its first two characters up with the last two we read, and comparison resumes at pattern index 2 — the text pointer never moves backwards.", từ "resume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to start again after a pause
items.explanation: resume /rɪˈzjuːm/ (động từ): tiếp tục lại. Động từ /rɪˈzjuːm/ = tiếp tục; danh từ "résumé" /ˈrezjumeɪ/ = sơ yếu lý lịch.
items.explanationEn: resume /rɪˈzjuːm/ (verb): to start again after a pause. The verb /rɪˈzjuːm/ means continue; the noun "résumé" /ˈrezjumeɪ/ is a CV.

items.question: Trong câu "These fall-back lengths depend only on the pattern, so KMP precomputes them into a table.", từ "precompute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: precompute /ˌpriːkəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính trước. Tiền tố "pre-" = trước: "precompute a table" = tính bảng từ trước để dùng lại.
items.explanationEn: precompute /ˌpriːkəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate in advance. The prefix "pre-" means before: "precompute a table" means building it ahead of use.

items.question: Trong câu "With the table ready, scan the text once.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to copy a picture into a computer
to go through from start to end

items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to go through from start to end. "Scan the array/text" means going through it in order; "linear scan" is a common term.

items.questionEn: In the sentence "j rises by at most 1 per character, so at most n times in total, and every fall-back strictly lowers j — so there are at most n fall-backs overall.", what does "rise" (verb) mean?

items.explanation: rise /raɪz/ (động từ): tăng lên. "Rise by 1" = tăng thêm 1 (nội động từ); "raise" là ngoại động từ.
items.explanationEn: rise /raɪz/ (verb): to increase. "Rise by 1" means increase by 1 (no object); "raise" takes an object.

items.question: Trong câu "j rises by at most 1 per character, so at most n times in total, and every fall-back strictly lowers j — so there are at most n fall-backs overall.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "j rises by at most 1 per character, so at most n times in total, and every fall-back strictly lowers j — so there are at most n fall-backs overall.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?

items.explanationEn: at most /ət məʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most" means not more than; opposite "at least". Do not confuse with "most".

items.question: Trong câu "j rises by at most 1 per character, so at most n times in total, and every fall-back strictly lowers j — so there are at most n fall-backs overall.", từ "in total" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: in total /ɪn ˈtəʊtl/ (cụm từ): tổng cộng. "In total" = cộng tất cả lại; tương tự "overall", "altogether".
items.explanationEn: in total /ɪn ˈtəʊtl/ (phrase): all added together. "In total" means counting everything together; similar to "overall", "altogether".

items.question: Trong câu "j rises by at most 1 per character, so at most n times in total, and every fall-back strictly lowers j — so there are at most n fall-backs overall.", từ "strictly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "j rises by at most 1 per character, so at most n times in total, and every fall-back strictly lowers j — so there are at most n fall-backs overall.", what does "strictly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: strictly /ˈstrɪktli/ (trạng từ): một cách ngặt. "Strictly decreasing" = giảm ngặt (luôn nhỏ hơn, không bằng); nghĩa thường là nghiêm khắc.
items.explanationEn: strictly /ˈstrɪktli/ (adverb): always, never equal. "Strictly decreasing" means always getting smaller, never equal; in daily use it means sternly.

items.question: Trong câu "Scanning is O(n), the table O(m): O(n + m) time, O(m) space, even on inputs that make naive search quadratic.", từ "quadratic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scanning is O(n), the table O(m): O(n + m) time, O(m) space, even on inputs that make naive search quadratic.", what does "quadratic" (adjective) mean?

items.explanation: quadratic /kwɒˈdrætɪk/ (tính từ): bậc hai. "Quadratic time" = O(n²); "linear" = O(n), "logarithmic" = O(log n).
items.explanationEn: quadratic /kwɒˈdrætɪk/ (adjective): growing with the square of n. "Quadratic time" is O(n²); compare "linear" O(n) and "logarithmic" O(log n).

items.question: Trong câu "Many lookups → sort once, then binary search: O(n log n + k log n) beats O(k · n) for large k.", từ "beat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many lookups → sort once, then binary search: O(n log n + k log n) beats O(k · n) for large k.", what does "beat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beat /biːt/ (động từ): tốt hơn, vượt qua. "X beats Y" = X hiệu quả hơn Y; nghĩa khác: đánh, tim đập.
items.explanationEn: beat /biːt/ (verb): to be better than. "X beats Y" means X performs better; other senses: to hit, a heart beating.

items.question: Trong câu "For pure membership, a Set gives O(1) average.", từ "membership" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For pure membership, a Set gives O(1) average.", what does "membership" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: whether an item belongs to a set
items.explanation: membership /ˈmembəʃɪp/ (danh từ): việc có thuộc tập hợp. "Membership test/check" = kiểm tra phần tử có trong tập không; nghĩa thường là tư cách thành viên.
items.explanationEn: membership /ˈmembəʃɪp/ (noun): whether an item belongs to a set. A "membership test" checks if an item is in a collection; normally it means belonging to a club.

items.question: Trong câu "For pure membership, a Set gives O(1) average.", từ "pure" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For pure membership, a Set gives O(1) average.", what does "pure" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pure /pjʊə/ (tính từ): chỉ đơn thuần. "Pure membership" = chỉ cần biết có/không, không cần vị trí; "pure function" = hàm không có tác dụng phụ.
items.explanationEn: pure /pjʊə/ (adjective): only that and nothing else. "Pure membership" means only yes/no, no position; "pure function" means a function without side effects.

items.question: Trong câu "Strings → in production use text.includes(pattern); engines use tuned algorithms.", từ "in production" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strings → in production use text.includes(pattern); engines use tuned algorithms.", what does "in production" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: while a film is being made
in the live system used by real users
items.explanation: in production /ɪn prəˈdʌkʃn/ (cụm từ): trên hệ thống thật. "In production" = trong môi trường chạy thật cho người dùng; đối lập "in development", "staging".
items.explanationEn: in production /ɪn prəˈdʌkʃn/ (phrase): in the live system used by real users. "In production" means in the live environment; contrast with "in development" or "staging".

items.question: Trong câu "Strings → in production use text.includes(pattern); engines use tuned algorithms.", từ "tuned" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Strings → in production use text.includes(pattern); engines use tuned algorithms.", what does "tuned" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: adjusted to the right musical pitch
items.explanation: tuned /tjuːnd/ (tính từ): đã được tinh chỉnh. "Highly tuned" = được tối ưu kỹ; "performance tuning" = tinh chỉnh hiệu năng.
items.explanationEn: tuned /tjuːnd/ (adjective): carefully adjusted for performance. "Highly tuned" means optimized in detail; "performance tuning" is the process.

items.question: Trong câu "Write KMP when asked or when you need a guaranteed linear worst case.", từ "guaranteed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write KMP when asked or when you need a guaranteed linear worst case.", what does "guaranteed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: guaranteed /ˌɡærənˈtiːd/ (tính từ): được đảm bảo. "Guaranteed O(n)" = chắc chắn O(n) kể cả trường hợp xấu nhất.
items.explanationEn: guaranteed /ˌɡærənˈtiːd/ (adjective): certain to be true. "Guaranteed O(n)" means O(n) is certain, even in the worst case.

items.question: Trong câu "Rabin–Karp and Boyer–Moore are other well-known options.", từ "well-known" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rabin–Karp and Boyer–Moore are other well-known options.", what does "well-known" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: well-known /ˌwel ˈnəʊn/ (tính từ): nổi tiếng, phổ biến. "A well-known algorithm/problem" = thuật toán/bài toán được biết đến rộng rãi.
items.explanationEn: well-known /ˌwel ˈnəʊn/ (adjective): known by many people. "A well-known algorithm/problem" is one that many people know about.

items.question: Trong câu "Use lower bound for first occurrence, insertion point and counting duplicates.", từ "occurrence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use lower bound for first occurrence, insertion point and counting duplicates.", what does "occurrence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: occurrence /əˈkʌrəns/ (danh từ): lần xuất hiện. "First/last occurrence" = lần xuất hiện đầu/cuối; động từ "occur" (chú ý viết hai chữ r).
items.explanationEn: occurrence /əˈkʌrəns/ (noun): an instance of something appearing. "First/last occurrence" is where something first/last appears; verb "occur" (note the double r).

items.question: Trong câu "Naive string search is O(n · m); KMP is O(n + m) time, O(m) space thanks to the LPS table, and never moves the text pointer back.", từ "thanks to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Naive string search is O(n · m); KMP is O(n + m) time, O(m) space thanks to the LPS table, and never moves the text pointer back.", what does "thanks to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: thanks to /θæŋks tuː/ (cụm từ): nhờ có. "Thanks to X" = nhờ X mà có kết quả tốt; khác với "thank you for" (cảm ơn).
items.explanationEn: thanks to /θæŋks tuː/ (phrase): because of, owing to. "Thanks to X" means X caused the good result; different from "thank you for".

items.question: Trong câu "Binary search halves the candidates each step: O(log n), but only on sorted, indexable data.", từ "halve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Binary search halves the candidates each step: O(log n), but only on sorted, indexable data.", what does "halve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: halve /hɑːv/ (động từ): giảm một nửa. "Halve" /hɑːv/ là động từ của "half"; đừng nhầm với "have" /hæv/.
items.explanationEn: halve /hɑːv/ (verb): to reduce by half. "Halve" /hɑːv/ is the verb from "half"; do not confuse it with "have" /hæv/.

items.question: Trong câu "Off-by-one bugs come from inconsistent bounds; keep the invariant and loop condition in step.", từ "inconsistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Off-by-one bugs come from inconsistent bounds; keep the invariant and loop condition in step.", what does "inconsistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inconsistent /ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): không nhất quán. "Inconsistent with…" = mâu thuẫn, không khớp với…; trái nghĩa "consistent".
items.explanationEn: inconsistent /ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): not following the same rules. "Inconsistent with…" means contradicting it; opposite "consistent".

items.question: Trong câu "Off-by-one bugs come from inconsistent bounds; keep the invariant and loop condition in step.", từ "in step" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Off-by-one bugs come from inconsistent bounds; keep the invariant and loop condition in step.", what does "in step" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in step /ɪn step/ (cụm từ): đồng bộ, khớp nhau. "Keep X in step with Y" = giữ X và Y khớp nhau; trái nghĩa "out of step".
items.explanationEn: in step /ɪn step/ (phrase): in agreement with each other. "Keep X in step with Y" means keeping them in agreement; opposite "out of step".
